sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f11f356e-967d-4099-9d87-5497790b397c', 'e0079cc8-3642-47f0-9d14-28fd8f212c21') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
